recommendation_summary: The reply recommends wrapping the nightly-sync script's entry point so any exception sends a "nightly-sync FAILED" email with the error, reusing the script's existing email code.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know within a day when `nightly-sync` fails, without reading logs (you).
labels.Deleted: Central log on the Synology, Docker, any log stack. You said you won't read logs, so storing them better doesn't tell you anything.
labels.Bottleneck: The job only emails on success. A crash before the email step means silence, and silence looks like nothing.
labels.Checked myself: Only what you told me: the token expiry crashed it at startup four nights running, before the email, and nothing else alerts. I haven't read the script.

note: The only thing it recommends now is a failure email; it explicitly holds off on an outside watcher, so that doesn't count.
